name: Lithium-ion battery cell (graphite anode)
description: Generic graphite-anode Li-ion cell — the demand sink for ~all battery-grade graphite. Anode active material is either coated spherical natural graphite (>99.95% C) or synthetic/artificial graphite; blends are common. Graphite is currently the only commercially viable anode host material at scale.

materials.component: Anode active material — coated spherical graphite (natural route)
materials.notes: Chain: mined flake concentrate -> size classification (small-to-medium mesh is the battery-optimal fraction, only ~49% of a 1.2 Mt global flake market in 2023) -> micronising -> purification to >99.95% C -> spheroidisation -> carbon coating -> AAM. Purification, spheroidisation and coating are the midstream chokepoint: <1% of uncoated spherical graphite output was outside China (2023 forecast) and China holds >80% of spherical graphite processing capacity. Emissions in the Chinese natural route are dominated by coating (41%), beneficiation (21%), spheroidisation (20%) and purification (14%); mining is only ~4%. Natural graphite is losing anode share to synthetic — Chinese natural graphite anode shipments fell to ~210 kt in 2025 while total Chinese anode shipments rose 39% to ~2.9 Mt.
materials.source: Benchmark Mineral Intelligence 2023; Park et al., Geosciences Journal (Springer) 2025 citing Engels et al. 2022; Metalnomist June 2026 (China 2025 shipment data)

materials.component: Anode active material — synthetic/artificial graphite (petroleum coke route)
materials.notes: Chain: low-sulphur petroleum coke or coal tar pitch / needle coke -> graphitisation at ~2,500-3,000 C -> milling/coating -> AAM. China accounted for 69% of global low-sulphur petroleum coke production (2023) and reportedly ~98% of graphitisation capacity, so the synthetic route is at least as concentrated as the natural one. Gaining share from natural graphite on cost, helped by the ability to use higher-sulphur pet coke instead of costlier needle coke. Ex-China capacity is small and mostly pre-commercial: ~2,000 t/yr at Vianode Via ONE (Norway), 20,000 t/yr targeted at NOVONIX Riverside (US).

site.name: Via ONE anode graphite plant, Herøya

materials.source: Benchmark Mineral Intelligence 2023 (pet coke share, feedstock economics); Metalshub 2026 (graphitisation share); Vianode and NOVONIX company releases 2024-25

name: High-nickel NMC cathode (EV battery)
maker: Multiple (Huayou Cobalt, POSCO Future M, LG/CATL supply chains)
description: Nickel-manganese-cobalt cathode active material for EV lithium-ion cells. Chain: laterite ore -> HPAL -> MHP (mixed hydroxide precipitate) -> battery-grade nickel/cobalt sulphate -> ternary precursor (pCAM) -> cathode active material (CAM) -> cell.

materials.component: Cathode active material — cobalt unit (cobalt in MHP -> cobalt sulphate)
materials.notes: Indonesian HPAL plants co-produce cobalt: MHP runs ~2-4% Co, and HPL/ONC on Obi Island produce cobalt sulphate directly. HNC nameplate includes ~6 kt/yr Co; HPL phase 1 cited at 4,400 t/yr Co. Huayou cobalt product shipments were ~46,500 t in 2025, roughly flat y/y. This makes Indonesia a growing second pole to DRC-sourced cobalt for battery cathodes.

site.name: PT Halmahera Persada Lygend (HPL) HPAL refinery

materials.source: Zhejiang Huayou Cobalt 2025 full-year results (Apr 2026); CRU via MMTA (2024); SMM (2021)

materials.component: Cathode active material — nickel unit (MHP -> nickel sulphate -> pCAM -> CAM)
materials.notes: Dominant 2025 route is Indonesian laterite via HPAL to MHP, refined to battery-grade nickel sulphate mostly in China, then ternary precursor and cathode. Huayou shipped >100,000 t of ternary cathode materials in 2025 (+108% y/y) and states 9-series ultra-high-nickel market share above 33%. Alternative route: high-grade nickel matte (e.g. Huake 45 kt/yr) or ferronickel-derived matte (SNNC -> POSCO).

site.name: PT Huayue Nickel Cobalt (HNC) HPAL refinery

materials.source: Zhejiang Huayou Cobalt 2025 full-year results (Apr 2026); Argus Media (2026)
